convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load 'SimpleBars' custom indicator with 2 buffers read (buffer 4 for signal detection). Also depends on external #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> for position management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Custom indicator logic must be manually reimplemented in Python.

derived_values.name: Col[0] - signal buffer value at SignalBar
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, 4, SignalBar, 2, Col) → Col[0] is current signal bar value (0 or 1), Col[1] is previous signal bar value

other_exits: Long position closed when Col[1]==1 (sell signal appears) and BuyPosClose input is true
Short position closed when Col[1]==0 (buy signal appears) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means fixed lot size of 0.1; other modes calculate fraction of balance/free margin

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic: Long when SimpleBars buffer 4 transitions from 0 to 1 (Col[1]==0 and Col[0]==1). Short when buffer transitions from 1 to 0 (Col[1]==1 and Col[0]==0). Signal is read at SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar). When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated every tick. A Recount mechanism re-reads indicator values if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs gate which directions are allowed to open/close. The CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls new-bar detection. LoadHistory() ensures sufficient bar history is loaded before signal evaluation.
external_dependencies: TradeAlgorithms.mqh - provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar
SimpleBars custom indicator - must be available in Indicators directory, provides buffer 4 with binary 0/1 trend direction values
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement SimpleBars indicator logic in Python. The indicator takes rperiod (default 6) and useclose (default true) parameters and outputs a binary 0/1 signal on buffer index 4. The signal logic appears to be a bar-counting trend filter: rperiod consecutive up-bars → 1 (bullish), rperiod consecutive down-bars → 0 (bearish), with useclose determining whether close or high/low is used for comparison. TradeAlgorithms.mqh position management must be replaced with simple market order logic. Entry: long on 0→1 transition, short on 1→0 transition, evaluated on completed bar (SignalBar=1). Fixed SL=1000 points, TP=2000 points. Position sizing supports 5 modes; default LOT mode = fixed 0.1 lot.
